title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
abstract: arXiv:2611.26007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. translated_title: System-One RSI：通过引导式练习为交互式智能体构建肌肉记忆
translated_abstract: 推理模型具备强大的多模态任务理解能力，但由于深思熟虑会增加决策延迟，它们难以实现亚秒级的实时控制。快速决策模型能够满足响应时间窗口的要求，然而仅靠提示词和少样本示例难以提供新任务所需的细粒度经验。受教练指导的运动学习启发，本文提出了System-One递归自我改进，该方法耦合了两个循环。高频在线内循环是一个“观察—定位—决策—行动”（OODA）循环：决策模型将每个视觉观察和任务问题映射为结构化判断，再由决策树将其转换为定时动作，全程无需调用推理模型。离线外循环则是由一组推理智能体执行的递归改进循环：该团队修订决策模型的提示词与决策树，捕获交互记录，从这些记录中推导监督信号，并训练……
tldr: 本文提出System-One RSI双循环框架，通过高频OODA内循环（决策模型加决策树，无需推理模型即可输出亚秒级定时动作）与推理智能体团队执行的离线递归改进外循环（修订提示词与决策树、从交互记录中生成监督信号），让交互式智能体像运动员一样通过引导式练习建立“肌肉记忆”，从而同时获得强任务理解能力与亚秒级实时控制。
en_tdlr: System-One RSI couples a high-frequency OODA inner loop (a decision model plus decision tree producing timed sub-second actions without invoking a reasoning model) with an offline recursive-improvement outer loop where reasoning agents revise prompts and decision trees and derive supervision from captured interaction records, enabling interactive agents to build "muscle memory" through guided practice for sub-second control.
